But Rustam was angry and said, "Your
men have stolen my horse. If I do not
get it back I will kill you and burn your
city." So the king sent out his men to
look for the horse.

Meanwhile Rustam stayed in the palace with the king. That night as he lay asleep, he had a sweet dream. He thought he saw a beautiful girl standing by his side. He opened his eyes and found that the dream had come true. For he

saw a beautiful girl
standing before him.
She was fairer than
all the other ladies
that he had ever
seen. Even at first
sight he fell in love
with her. "Who are
you?" he asked her.

"I am Tahminah," she answered,
"and I am the daughter of the king of
Samangan."
